capabilities: Java causal discovery library and GUI
limitation: Deployment and licensing cost; graph semantics must survive serialization
inspection: Primary README/license/package or repository metadata; selected API source where saved. No runtime package benchmark.
pin_limit: Content hashes pin actual saved artifacts. Retrieved HEAD, if present, is a separate observation; mutable-branch files are not asserted to belong to that commit.

scientific_qualification.input: A chosen discovery search and its test/score/data schema; exact search API still requires inspection.
scientific_qualification.output: Search-specific graph through Java library/GUI or a separately pinned language bridge.
scientific_qualification.assumptions: Each search retains its own equivalence class, latent-variable and sampling restrictions.
scientific_qualification.adapter_rule: Do not count a Java repository snapshot as a qualified Python adapter. Pin tetrad-lib, bridge and JDK; README currently names JDK25+ and describes bridge installation as nonstandard.
scientific_qualification.acceptance_test: For a selected FCI/PC route, compare oracle graph endpoints with the Python reference and require lossless cross-language graph serialization.

evidence.finding: Java model/GUI separation, Python/R bridges and runtime requirements; no selected search implementation inspected.
